check.label: Private key or the contents of the key file
check.local: The check runs only in this browser; nothing of it is sent.
check.ok: It fits: this is the private key for this public key.
check.wrong: It doesn't fit. This is not the private key for this public key, or the file is incomplete.
check.intro: Checks that the key you keep fits this club. Best once a year, or when someone on the board changes.

intro.p1: Hubra backs up your club's data every night. The backups are encrypted, and so far only the operator of Hubra can open them.
intro.p2: With a key of your own, every new backup is also encrypted for you. Then you can open your backups yourself, for example if you ever leave Hubra or want to keep a copy of your data outside Hubra.
intro.pair: The key has two parts: Hubra gets the public key (age1…) so it can lock backups for you. Only you keep the private key (AGE-SECRET-KEY-1…); only it opens the backups.
intro.browser: The key is made here in your browser. The private part is never sent to Hubra, and Hubra cannot recover it.
intro.loss: If the private key gets lost, you lose no data: Hubra can still restore your backups with its own key. You just can't open them yourselves any more. That holds as long as you don't turn on «Only our key».

activateFailed: The key could not be saved

wizard.replaceTitle: Set up a new backup key
wizard.title: Set up your own backup key
wizard.replaceHint: Backups made so far still open with the old key. Keep it until those backups have expired.

own.label: Public key (age1…)
own.hint: For example from «age-keygen» or a password manager that makes age keys. Paste only the public part.
own.private: That is the private key. It doesn't belong here; paste only the public key (age1…).
own.invalid: That is not an age public key (age1…).
own.open: I already have an age key

generated: Your key pair is ready. Right now it exists only in this browser window.

store.intro: Save the key file somewhere safe now. Once you leave this page, the private key is gone from here.
store.manager: Best in the club's password manager (e.g. Bitwarden, 1Password or KeePass) as a secure note or attachment.
store.second: A second copy with another board member, or printed in a safe place, so the key doesn't depend on one person.
store.never: Don't send it by email or chat, don't put it in Hubra, and don't keep it openly in a shared folder.
store.delete: Once you have downloaded the file and put it in the password manager, delete it from your downloads folder.
store.ack: I have stored the private key safely.
store.ackLoss: I understand that Hubra doesn't know the private key and cannot recover it.

confirm.intro: Show that the stored key is right: open it where you saved it and paste it here, or choose the file. Only then is the key activated.

done.title: Done
done.text: From the next backup on, every backup of your club is also encrypted with your key.

removeFailed: The key could not be removed

status.title: Your own backup key
status.notYet: This server doesn't encrypt backups with public keys yet. Your key is saved and applies as soon as the operator switches over.
status.nextBackup: The next backup will be encrypted with your key.

open.title: How to open a backup
open.file: You get a backup file (ending in .dump.age) from the operator of your Hubra install. You open it with the free tool age (age-encryption.org):
open.restore: The decrypted file is a PostgreSQL dump; pg_restore loads it into a database of your own.

removeConfirm: New backups will then only be encrypted with the operator's key, and «Only our key» is turned off. Backups made so far still open with your private key, so keep it.
loadFailed: The backup key could not be loaded.

clubOnly.onDone: Only your key opens new backups now
clubOnly.offDone: Hubra can open new backups again
clubOnly.failed: The setting could not be saved
clubOnly.title: Only our key
clubOnly.hint: New backups are then encrypted with your key only, no longer with Hubra's key as well. Nobody but you can open them, not even Hubra.
clubOnly.active: On: Hubra cannot restore new backups of your club. If your private key gets lost, those backups are lost. Your data in Hubra itself is not affected.
clubOnly.risk1: Hubra can no longer open or restore new backups of your club, not even if you ask.
clubOnly.risk2: For a restore you have to provide your private key yourselves. If it is lost, there is no way back.
clubOnly.risk3: Backups made so far stay as they are. You can turn the setting off at any time; that applies from the next backup.
clubOnly.ack: We keep our private key in at least two safe places, and I understand Hubra can't help if it is missing.
clubOnly.slug: To confirm, type the club's short name: {{slug}}
